name: AJAZZ AK650
description: The AJAZZ AK650 punches way above its weight class, offering premium features like a flex-cut polycarbonate plate, 5-pin hot-swappable PCB, and a rare display and slider combo in a tight 65% form factor. An absolute dream for Windows users on a budget.
specs:
Layout: 65%

Mounting Style: Gasket Mount (Silicon jackets with flex-cut PC plate)

Connectivity: Tri-Mode (Wired, 2.4GHz, Bluetooth)

Battery Capacity: 5000 mAh

Switches: Huano Dreamweaving or Flying Fish (Linear, Factory Lubed)

PCB: 5-Pin Hot-Swappable, South-facing RGB, 1.2mm flex cut

Keycaps: Double-shot PBT (Cherry Profile)

Polling Rate: 1000Hz (Wired/2.4GHz), 125Hz (Bluetooth)
